Q1.rationale: Segments 10, 11 and 21 limit use of Confidential Information to the Purpose stated in the Agreement.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: The definition covers marked information or information whose nature or circumstances of disclosure make it confidential, but does not expressly mention verbal disclosure.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: Segment 26 states some obligations survive termination or expiry of the Agreement.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: Segment 30 requires the Receiving Party to notify the Disclosing Party if required by law, regulation or judicial process to disclose Confidential Information.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q5.rationale: Segment 58 states no license or right to the Confidential Information is granted.
Q5.label: Entailment

Q6.rationale: Segment 19 includes many technical items but also other business information, so it is not limited to technical information.
Q6.label: Contradiction

Q7.rationale: The NDA contains no clause prohibiting solicitation of the Disclosing Party's representatives or employees.
Q7.label: NotMentioned

Q8.rationale: Segment 52 states the Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that the Agreement was agreed or negotiated.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: The NDA has no residuals clause; segment 21 limits use to the Purpose, which is incompatible with free use of retained knowledge.
Q9.label: Contradiction

Q13.rationale: Segment 56 states the Receiving Party may share Confidential Information with third parties including consultants, agents and professional advisors, subject to segment 23 conditions.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Segments 54 and 55 state the Receiving Party may share some Confidential Information with some of its employees.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segment 65 recognizes the Recipient may receive information from other parties that is similar to the Confidential Information.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 44 permits copies reasonably required for the stated purpose and segment 45 refers to retained copies.
Q17.label: Entailment

Q18.rationale: Segment 58 grants no license or right to Confidential Information, which is incompatible with assigning ownership to the Receiving Party.
Q18.label: Contradiction

Q19.rationale: Segments 40 to 42 contain an exception permitting disclosure in confidence to government officials or attorneys to report suspected violations of law, so the no-exception claim is incompatible.
Q19.label: Contradiction

Q20.rationale: Remedy is injunctive relief only; no fixed sum or penalty payable on breach is provided.
Q20.label: NotMentioned
